name: Chondromyxoid Fibroma
definition: Rare benign cartilaginous/myxoid bone tumor, commonly arising eccentrically in the metaphysis of long bones in young patients.

investigations.principle: Radiographs and MRI characterize lesion; biopsy confirms diagnosis before definitive surgery.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Curettage is common but recurrence requires follow-up.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi-granthi phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Rare benign cartilaginous/myxoid bone tumor, commonly arising eccentrically in the metaphysis of long bones in young patients.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, major trauma, suspected infection, pathological fracture, neurovascular compromise or other listed red flags.
